note: Both sets capture the same core facts (module lengths 12'-3 3/4" and 10'-3 3/4", the 3/8" through bolts, L3X3X1/4 angles, and the loose dimension strings). Set A additionally captures the L3X3X1/4 member profile for Module A, which is supported by the L3X3X1/4 labels in the A1 detail and is missing from Set B. Set A's only defect is one duplicated through-bolt claim (stated twice, once bare and once with S-301), which is a redundancy rather than a misstatement. On balance A covers more of the page correctly.
remarks: Both sets bind several bare dimension strings (3'-8 3/8", 3'-6", 3'-1 5/16") to a generic 'PV Detail' entity, so the values are read correctly but the component/property binding is vague. The 5/16" bolt value for Module A is not present in the text layer and is only faintly legible in the A1 detail; both sets assert it, so it does not differentiate them, but it should be verified. 'S-301' is a reference callout rather than a condition on the bolt. Many small dimensions on the page (6", 1 1/2", 7 1/16", 2'-2 7/8", 6 3/16", 3", 4 13/16", 2", 4", 5/8", 2'-3 7/8", 7'-0", 2'-11 7/8", 6 13/16", 1'-11 1/8", 2'-5 5/16", 4 3/4") are omitted by both sets.
